subject.title: Feature request: configurable lane wait diagnostic threshold

question: Should OpenClaw accept `diagnostics.laneWaitWarnMs` as a public diagnostics config key, and should the setting hot-apply to future queue entries or require restart?
rationale: The log-noise problem is source-confirmed, but the fix adds compatibility-sensitive public config surface and an open PR already owns the implementation path.

options.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, tests, and reload planning all agree that future queue entries pick up runtime config changes.

options.title: Accept restart-only setting
options.body: Allow the config key but document and test restart-required semantics instead of promising live config reload behavior.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Keep the threshold fixed or solve log noise through broader diagnostics policy, then close the linked implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, tests, and reload planning all agree that future queue entries pick up runtime config changes.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combination of queue feature history and issue-specific config/docs/test guidance.
